bugs_found: fx_convert: when from_currency == to_currency, multiplies by rates.get((c,c), 1) instead of returning amount unchanged — if the dict contains a non-1 entry for (c,c) the result is wrong
compound_interest: missing validation for negative principal (p < 0 not checked)
loan_payment: when r == 0 returns p/m as Decimal division which may produce non-quantized result; also no rounding to currency precision anywhere
transfer: not atomic — if a later step raised between the two balance assignments, state would be inconsistent (no rollback/transaction)
apply_fee: fee computed as a*pct assumes pct is a fraction (e.g. 0.01) but naming 'fee_pct' suggests percentage; ambiguous contract / no documentation
fx_convert: rate accepted via Decimal(str(rate)) but rates dict values type is unconstrained; no validation that rate > 0
No monetary rounding/quantize applied to results (compound_interest, loan_payment, apply_fee, fx_convert) — financial outputs should be quantized to currency precision
Account.balance and amounts have no invariant enforcement (could be constructed with negative balance or non-Decimal types)
